source_preparation: Plain-knitted PET fabric, 100 g/m2, Zhejiang Xinjian Textiles. Thermofixed fabric cleaned with NaOH 30 g/l at 90 C for 20 min and acetone Soxhlet for 24 h. Pretreated fabric soaked 24 h in acetone/monomer solution; source says quart glass; irradiated by Van De Graff 5 MeV electron accelerator in air at room temperature. Specific thermal/LOI aliquot absorbed dose and bath concentration are not identified. Figure 2 uses 200 kGy for a graft-yield study, not an automatically assigned assay dose. Post-irradiation boiling DI water 6 h, acetone Soxhlet 24 h, drying105 C24 h. These are preparation extractions, not durability laundering. Table1/figure captions identify DG55.4% AAc,25.98% AAm,10.9% DMVP as grafted/original mass gain; no inferred retained monomer fraction. Source generic monomer-concentration discussion and sample DG values are kept distinct.
source_title: Thermal performance and flammability of poly(ethylene terephthalate) fabrics grafted with different monomers followed by electron beam irradiation
